correctness.rationale: The exact beta-integral coefficient formula is verified. Uniform gamma-ratio asymptotics and L^2 first derivatives give a Hilbert--Schmidt difference from the homogeneous integral kernel; a logarithmic unitary identifies its Wiener--Hopf Fourier multiplier with the explicitly stated beta function. The standard Fredholm symbol theorem gives all nonzero spectral points and index, and weakly-null basis columns show zero also belongs. For integer b the gamma recurrence plus Euler cosh product prove strictly decreasing phase and modulus, so every nonzero double point is enumerated and transverse. The bundled standard-library checker passed 6,909 finite assertions; the proof, not these checks, carries all quantifiers.

value.rationale: The recently determined norm of this natural generalized Hilbert operator does not fix Fredholm invertibility. The finding supplies the exact Calkin/Fredholm boundary and all integer index windings for every positive real parameter, and exposes an unbounded hierarchy of genuine transversal spectral self-crossings at integral parameters. This is a motivated complete nonselfadjoint spectral invariant plus a natural parameter classification, beyond a routine norm estimate or finite-table computation. The full spectrum and noninteger double-point classification are explicitly left open.
